description: Runs the site's Process Prioritizer on up to 10 manual processes (name, hours per week, frequency, complexity, error-prone, people involved). Returns each one's score out of 100, priority, estimated annual savings, reasoning and implementation timeline, ranked, plus totals and service recommendations. Use it when a user lists several things they might automate.

hoursPerWeek.description: Hours per week it takes (1 to 40)

name.description: What the process is, e.g. "Invoice processing"

name: prioritize_processes
title: Prioritize processes to automate
